paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah thu agen a,
heading: Puanin Siangthou Latna / (Eks 35.4-9)

paite: "Thillat ahon tawitheihna ding un, Israel suante kiang ah thu gen in. Michih lungtang a uttak a pete a pan thilpiak na la ding hi.
Amau a pan thilpiak na lak ding hiai bang ahi. Dangka-eng leh dangka leh dal.
Puanmalngat dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au leh khau hoih leh kel mul.
Belampa vun sansaksa leh ngalvang vun leh singgi sing.
Vak ding in sathau, thaunuh ding gimlim, gimnamtui a ding toh.
Onik suangte, siampu puan leh awmtuamna a siat ding suangte.
Alak ua ka tentheihna ding in mun siangthou hon bawlsak uhen.
Nang ka hon etsak bangbang in, biakbuk lim bang in leh avanzat tengteng lim bang in na bawl ding ahi.
"Singgi sing in thukhun bawm na bawl ding ahi. Adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi dia, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
heading: Thukhun Bawm / (Eks 37.1-9)

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, asunglam leh apolam na luan dia, akimvel ah dangka-eng lallukhu bawl in atung ah na bawl ding ahi.
Dangka-eng in asikkual li na sung dia, aning lite ah na bulh ding hi. Sikkual nih apang khat ah a-om ding ua, sikkual dang nihte apang khat ah a-om ding uh.
Singgi sing chiang na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan ding ahi.
Thukhun bawm sik a sikkualte sung ah chiangte na thunlut dia, huaite thukhun bawm zawn ahihtheihna ding in.
Chiangte thukhun bawm sikkual sung ah a-om ding uhi.
Thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak theihsakna dudes na koih ding ahi.
"Dangka-engtak in zahngaihna tutphah na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih-le-akim ahi dia, availam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
Zahngaihna tutphah mong nihte ah, dangka-eng in cherubte na bawl dia, huaite sekthoh e in na bawl ding ahi.
Among khat ah cherub khat na bawl dia, among langkhat ah cherub dang. Among nihte ah zahngaihna tutphah ah cherubte na bawl ding ahi.
Cherubte'n tungsang lam ah akhate uh azakkhe ding ua, akhate ua zahngaihna tutphah tuam in, amai un aki-entuah ding ua; zahngaihna tutphah lam ah cherubte mai a-om ding ahi.
Thukhun bawm tung ah zahngaihna tutphah na koih dia; thukhun bawm sung ah ka hon piak ding theihsakna na koih ding ahi.

Huai ah ka hon kimuhpih dia, zahngaihna tutphah tung a pan, theihsakna thukhun bawm tung a om cherub nihte kikal a pan Israel suante kiang a thupiak ka hon piak ding thil tengteng thu ah ka hon houpih ding hi.
"Singgi in dohkan na bawl dia; adunglam tong nih ahi dia; availam tong khat, asanlam tong khat-le-akim ahi ding hi.
heading: Pathian Kiang A Tanghou Latna Dohkan / (Eks 37.10-16)

paite: Dangka-engtak in na luan dia, akımvel in dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
Akimvel in khut chia in agei na bawl dia; akimvel in agei ah dangka-eng lallukhu na bawl ding ahi.
Asikkual ding in dangka-eng in li na bawl dia; sikkualte aning lite akhe li tung a omte ah na koih ding.
Dohkan puakna ding chiangte a-omna ding in ageichin ah sikkualte a-om ding uh ahi.
Singgi in chiangte na bawl dia, dangka-eng in na luan dia, huaite dohkan akipuaktheihna ding ahi.
Akuangte, akeute, asinte, anoute, asitna ding in na bawl ding hi. Huaite dangka-engtak in na bawl ding ahi.
Ka ma a dohkan tung ah tanghou sawm-le-nih na koih gige ding ahi.
"Dangka-engtak in khawnvak koihna na bawl ding ahi. Khawnvak koihna sekthoh in na bawl ding ahi. Akungpi leh ahiangte, apakmum leh apakte, kibang mah in na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Khawnvak Koihna / (Eks 37.17-24)

paite: Apangte a pan hiang guk akakhe dia; khawnvak koihna pang khat a pan hiang thum, khawnvak koihna pang dang a pan hiang thum.
Belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, hiang khat a pakmum leh pak; hiang dang a belkuang thumte makha bang a bawlte, pakmum leh pak; huchibang in khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suak hiang gukte.
Khawnvak koihna ah belkuang li makha bang a bawl a-om ding ahi, apakmumte leh pakte uh toh.
Huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah pakmum khat a-om dia, huai mah ahiang nihte nuai ah apakmum khawnvak koihna a pan a hong suakkhia hiang gukte dungzui in.
Apakmumte leh ahiangte akibang ding ua, avek in dangka-engtak a sekthoh ahi ding hi.
Huai ah khawnvak sagih na bawl dia; khawnvakte ade ding ua, apang a vakna apiaktheihna ding un.
Ataitehte leh ameivu kuangte, dangka-engtak ahi ding ua;
belsuan tengteng toh dangka-engtak talent khat a bawl ding ahi.
Tang a ka hon etsak lim dungzui a bawl ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
